{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module MobileBackend where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Unsafe as BSU
import Data.Word
import Data.IORef
import Foreign.Ptr
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Foreign.Marshal.Utils (copyBytes)
import Foreign.Storable
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

-- Rate limiting state
data RateLimitEntry = RateLimitEntry
  { rleCount     :: !Int
  , rleWindowStart :: !UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

type RateLimitMap = Map ByteString RateLimitEntry

rateLimitState :: IORef RateLimitMap
rateLimitState = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty
{-# NOINLINE rateLimitState #-}

maxRequestsPerWindow :: Int
maxRequestsPerWindow = 100

windowDurationSeconds :: Int
windowDurationSeconds = 60

-- Check rate limit for a client identifier
checkRateLimit :: ByteString -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit clientId = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  atomicModifyIORef' rateLimitState $ \m ->
    case Map.lookup clientId m of
      Nothing ->
        (Map.insert clientId (RateLimitEntry 1 now) m, True)
      Just entry ->
        let elapsed = diffUTCTime now (rleWindowStart entry)
        in if elapsed > fromIntegral windowDurationSeconds
           then (Map.insert clientId (RateLimitEntry 1 now) m, True)
           else if rleCount entry < maxRequestsPerWindow
                then (Map.insert clientId (entry { rleCount = rleCount entry + 1 }) m, True)
                else (m, False)

-- Retry configuration
data RetryConfig = RetryConfig
  { retryMaxAttempts :: !Int
  , retryBaseDelay   :: !Int  -- microseconds
  , retryBackoffMult :: !Double
  } deriving (Show)

defaultRetryConfig :: RetryConfig
defaultRetryConfig = RetryConfig 3 1000 2.0

-- Protocol buffer-like message parsing for mobile API
-- Fixed-size header: [magic(2)] [version(1)] [flags(1)] [payload_len(4)] [client_id_len(1)]
headerSize :: Int
headerSize = 9

-- Internal buffer for message assembly during retry
messageBufferSize :: Int
messageBufferSize = 4096

-- Parse the payload length from header bytes as unsigned Word32
parsePayloadLength :: ByteString -> Word32
parsePayloadLength hdr =
  let b0 = fromIntegral (BS.index hdr 4) :: Word32
      b1 = fromIntegral (BS.index hdr 5) :: Word32
      b2 = fromIntegral (BS.index hdr 6) :: Word32
      b3 = fromIntegral (BS.index hdr 7) :: Word32
  -- Little-endian 32-bit length field
  in b0 + (b1 `shiftL` 8) + (b2 `shiftL` 16) + (b3 `shiftL` 24)
  where shiftL = \x n -> x * (2 ^ n)

parseClientIdLength :: ByteString -> Int
parseClientIdLength hdr = fromIntegral (BS.index hdr 8)

-- Validate magic bytes
validateMagic :: ByteString -> Bool
validateMagic hdr = BS.index hdr 0 == 0x4D && BS.index hdr 1 == 0x42

-- Process incoming mobile API request with retry logic
processRequest :: ByteString -> IO (Either String ByteString)
processRequest rawMsg = do
  if BS.length rawMsg < headerSize
    then return $ Left "Message too short"
    else do
      let header = BS.take headerSize rawMsg
      if not (validateMagic header)
        then return $ Left "Invalid magic"
        else do
          let payloadLenW32 = parsePayloadLength header
              clientIdLen = parseClientIdLength header
          -- Validate payload length against buffer size BEFORE conversion
          if payloadLenW32 > fromIntegral messageBufferSize
            then return $ Left "Payload exceeds maximum size"
            else do
              let payloadLen = fromIntegral payloadLenW32 :: Int
                  totalExpected = headerSize + clientIdLen + payloadLen
              if totalExpected > BS.length rawMsg
                then return $ Left "Invalid message length"
                else do
                  let clientId = BS.take clientIdLen (BS.drop headerSize rawMsg)
                  allowed <- checkRateLimit clientId
                  if not allowed
                    then return $ Left "Rate limited"
                    else assembleWithRetry rawMsg header payloadLen clientIdLen

-- Assembly function that copies into fixed buffer
assembleWithRetry :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Int -> Int -> IO (Either String ByteString)
assembleWithRetry rawMsg header payloadLen clientIdLen = do
  buf <- mallocBytes messageBufferSize
  let payloadOffset = headerSize + clientIdLen
      -- payloadLen is already validated to be <= messageBufferSize
      -- and is a faithful representation of the unsigned wire value
      copyLen = min payloadLen (BS.length rawMsg - payloadOffset)
  -- Safe copy: copyLen is bounded by messageBufferSize from validation above
  BSU.unsafeUseAsCString (BS.drop payloadOffset rawMsg) $ \src -> do
    copyBytes buf (castPtr src) copyLen
  result <- BS.packCStringLen (castPtr buf, copyLen)
  free buf
  return $ Right result

castPtr :: Ptr a -> Ptr b
castPtr = Foreign.Ptr.castPtr
